item.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
item.description: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
item.description: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph

item.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
item.description: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
item.description: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph

item.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
item.description: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
item.description: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin holds below $70K as stocks slip despite a cooler US PPI print
item.description: Bitcoin was down about 4% on the day amid a tepid market reaction to October’s US PPI reading, which came in below expected levels.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
item.description: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
item.description: A $5.8 million Bitcoin options loss pushed Nakamoto’s quarterly operating revenue below zero, while the company extended repayment of $60 million in Kraken debt to 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe
item.description: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
item.description: Unocoin said the transfers were signed and broadcast outside BitGo’s platform, and BitGo said the account freeze worked as intended.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin returns to 200-week trend line as analyst sees risk of $57.7K next
item.description: Bitcoin price action interacted with its 200-week simple moving average for the first time since mid-August as it fell below $68,000.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam
item.description: Authorities froze over $2.7 billion in Binance hack proceeds, while the separate FaceStealer scam stole over $400 million in 18 months.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
item.description: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook email and Teams calendars worldwide
item.description: Microsoft began a wider patch rollout Friday as the outage disrupted government email and Microsoft 365 connectors in ChatGPT and Claude.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin slides below $70K amid thin liquidity, ETF outflows
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 as crypto sentiment hit its lowest level in more than four months, with analysts warning of institutional outflows, thinning liquidity and elevated leverage.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks
item.description: The White House also named a former CFTC commissioner and two CLARITY Act veterans as nominees to fill vacancies at the SEC and CFTC.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had third alleged affair: Reuters
item.description: Reuters reported that Jensen Huang had a relationship with another Nvidia employee, hours after he resigned as CEO.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Gemini’s quarterly retail trading volume sinks to 3-year low
item.description: Gemini’s third-quarter trading rebound masked a deepening retail slump.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Maple Finance’s strategy rift sends co-founder, COO to the exits
item.description: Maple Finance co-founder Joe Flanagan and COO Ryan O’Shea are leaving over disagreements about the firm’s direction as SYRUP falls despite revenue growth.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: NK hackers join memecoin trenches, xStocks adds Hong Kong equities: Asia Express
item.description: North Korean hackers launch memecoins to launder funds stolen in the Binance hack, while xStocks plans to add hundreds of Hong Kong-listed equities in the coming weeks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
item.description: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Strategy stock sheds 5% amid MSCI index removal, Bitcoin sell-off
item.description: Strategy shares declined Thursday following MSCI’s decision to remove the company from its indexes, as Bitcoin also fell amid a broader crypto market decline.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: US Justice Department, business groups and DeFi firms challenge Illinois crypto tax
item.description: Industry groups argued in court filings that Illinois’ crypto tax, which applies even when a transaction yields no profit, could raise compliance costs and violate federal law.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: DTCC Plans Solana Expansion as Wallet Rules Limit Access
item.description: The US securities clearinghouse plans to bring tokenized stocks to Solana in 2027, but analysts say restrictions could limit adoption.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Bitcoin slides toward $71K as Nvidia stock tumbles after Huang steps down
item.description: Bitcoin fell to its lowest leve since Aug. 20 as tech stocks slid following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
item.description: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
item.description: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
